title: Local data with SQLite

spans.text: WHY USE THIS?
SQLite stores data in SQL tables for small applications; query parameters keep user values separate from SQL code.
CORE EXPLANATION
sqlite3 stores structured data for small apps without a separate server. Parameterize queries and use a transaction when several changes must succeed together.
EXAMPLE CODE
QUESTION: What will this code print? Predict first, then run it.

spans.code:
import sqlite3

with sqlite3.connect('app.db') as db:
    db.execute('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notes (text TEXT)')
    db.execute('INSERT INTO notes VALUES (?)', ('Hello',))

spans.text: EXPECTED RESULT

spans.code: No console output; creates the table if needed and inserts one row.

spans.title: Important tip
spans.text: Do not concatenate user input into SQL; pass values as parameters.

spans.title: Warning
spans.text: Formatting user values into SQL creates injection risk; use placeholders.
PRACTICE EXAMPLE 2 · Local data with SQLite
QUESTION: What will this code print? Predict first, then run it.

spans.code:
import sqlite3
connection = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
connection.execute('CREATE TABLE scores (name TEXT, value INTEGER)')
connection.execute('INSERT INTO scores VALUES (?, ?)', ('Ada', 10))
print(connection.execute('SELECT name, value FROM scores').fetchone())
connection.close()
